class.name: Process
class.brief_description: Runs and controls a child process with redirected standard streams.
class.description: [Process] provides a non-blocking object wrapper around a child process. Create one with [method create], then poll and read its standard output and error lines. Standard input is writable only when [code]open_stdin[/code] is [code]true[/code]. The child process is terminated when the last reference to this object is released.

method.name: close_stdin
method.description: Closes standard input without closing the process output streams.

method.name: create
method.description: Starts [param path] with [param arguments]. An empty [param working_directory] uses the engine executable directory. Returns [code]null[/code] if the platform cannot create the process.

method.name: get_available_stderr_lines
method.description: Returns the number of complete standard-error lines ready to read.

method.name: get_available_stdout_lines
method.description: Returns the number of complete standard-output lines ready to read.

method.name: get_exit_status
method.description: Returns the child exit status, or [code]-1[/code] while it is still running.

method.name: get_stderr_line
method.description: Returns and removes the next available standard-error line.

method.name: get_stdout_line
method.description: Returns and removes the next available standard-output line.

method.name: kill
method.description: Terminates the child process. [param force] is retained for compatibility; platform termination behavior is defined by [method OS.kill].

method.name: write
method.description: Writes [param input] to standard input. Returns [code]false[/code] if input was not opened or the write failed.
